parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, decriminalised since 2008, foreign documents presumed accepted, health-resolution non-discrimination covering gender identity, and a long-standing Pride — so no tier-1 universal exposure (no facility ban, custody/ward rule, or border friction) is documented. But there is no anti-discrimination machinery reaching gender identity in services, no trans-specific hate-crime aggravator, and the record shows anti-LGBT violence that is 'culturally accepted and legally unenforced', with police themselves recorded among aggressors (10 in 2021; tied with family in 2022) and authorities not investigating — state-tolerated hostility with no realistic remedy (tier 3, edging tier 2). Violence counts lack denominators, so magnitude is undocumented, not exculpatory; media suppression and under-reporting mean silence on visitor-specific incidents is not safety. Placed in Elevated Risk, above the universal-exclusion anchors.
